title: Turkish Lentil Stew (Mexican Inspired)
description: A hearty, flavorful stew made with Turkish lentils, smoky spices, and gooey cheese.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened, 5 minutes.
Add Turkish lentil and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add Smoky Paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add 4 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Stir in Tomato and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in Gooey Cheddar Cheese until melted and gooey.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro, if desired.
